scope: Requested NAVC-001/010/011 host case coverage. Public EARS/plan and visible assertion bodies only. No production or holdout bodies read for this audit; no repository edit, device, Cloud run or rerun.

assertionMap.case: All five saved business-type contexts retain actual mixed service names and teacher/instructor/trainer wording
assertionMap.assertions: For each of gym,dance,yoga,martial_arts,studio: renders the real ClassesPane under the saved-type context; visible text contains both Hatha Yoga and Contemporary beginners and the canonical trainer/instructor/teacher noun. It does not rely on the test title.

assertionMap.case: All five business hubs and shared announcement headings
assertionMap.assertions: For all five type/place pairs: actually renders Home and hub and matches From your {gym|academy|studio} and Your {place}.

assertionMap.case: All five hub success/error title hierarchy
assertionMap.assertions: Explicit five-case golden My gym/My academy/My studio. Success asserts eyebrow exists before the BIZ Academy heading and heading font is larger; error asserts the exact place title and excludes the successful business name.
Exact generated business_type enum/order equals gym,dance,yoga,martial_arts,studio; each type equals all eight literal golden nouns and role labels.

assertionMap.case: Business type does not gate or rename enabled primary Classes access
assertionMap.assertions: All five contexts assert the exact ordered five native destinations Home,Classes,Shop,You,Activity with fixed Classes title.

assertionMap.case: Mixed activity catalogue does not silently change saved gym type
assertionMap.assertions: Both actual activity filters exist, dance occurrence precedes yoga occurrence, and seam.context.businessType remains gym. Host assertion only; adding a service through a real persisted command is outside this audit.

assertionMap.case: Fetched saved vocabulary and foreground refresh/cache retention
assertionMap.assertions: Member/staff fetch own organization business_type, render dance nouns, persist tenant/type cache; active refresh changes to yoga then martial_arts with exact cache/type assertions; offline/failure retains known dance nouns. This provider suite does not separately fetch all five types.

assertionMap.case: Stable service identity despite duplicate names
assertionMap.assertions: Two distinct service IDs both named Movement produce two filters; pressing second shows Second service sentinel and excludes First service sentinel.

Fixture dance starts16:00 and yoga18:00 on same local date; rendered Dance sentinel index precedes Yoga sentinel, and both service filters exist. Adjacent filter test separately asserts the Dance sentinel is present.

assertionMap.case: Branch-local date filter crossing UTC date
assertionMap.assertions: Dance on Oct7 at00:30+05:30 has UTC dateOct6; selecting 7 Oct 2026 shows Dance, excludes Oct6 Yoga, preserves own distant-branch commitment.
Dance exists on another date; selecting Dance on current day excludes its timetable row, asserts a truthful no-scheduled-for-day message, retains All activities control and own booking.

assertionMap.case: Removed selected activity resets rather than leaving an invalid filter
assertionMap.assertions: Select Hatha Yoga and assert Dance excluded; refreshed authorized catalogue contains only Dance; render now shows Dance plus All activities control and own booking. This verifies invalid-selection recovery; it does not inspect the visual active-state marker of All.

assertionMap.case: My bookings independent of activity/date/catalogue branch and empty catalogue
assertionMap.assertions: Dance filter keeps Booked distant branch Yoga, Commitment-only branch and Cancel control; date filter keeps same commitment; empty authorized catalogue still calls independent own-bookings reader and displays own branch/local23:45/cancel; bookingsOnly excludes timetable Yoga/Dance and offers no new Book; cancelled commitments have no Book/Cancel; own-reader failure has retry, not false no-bookings.

assertionMap.case: Filtering and refreshing do not mutate booking/cancellation
assertionMap.assertions: Focus/resume refresh both catalogue and own readers, replaces old facts with fresh; cancelled own bookings stay cancelled with no actions; book and cancel mocks remain uncalled. This is host command-boundary evidence, not SQL serialization proof.

Named existing request schemas accept valid commands and reject caller identity fields; canonical generated booking/session statuses and limits are exact; arbitrary Yoga service name trimmed without an activity-type field; immutable rule identity, valid local start-day boundaries, explicit attendance vocabularies, availability labels, day strips and refusal messages asserted. Does not execute authoritative database booking eligibility/concurrency.

assertionMap.case: Shared own-booking projection retains stable identity, branch-local date and booking/cancellation/capacity facts
assertionMap.assertions: Exact projected object preserves Salsa beginners, service/session/branch identities, Etc/GMT+12 local Oct5 against UTC Oct6, capacity20/booked1/spots19, booked state/cancel deadline; callerless RPC exact; private scope fields stripped; [] differs from failed null; cancelled states preserved.

assertionMap.case: Native hub My classes enters independent bookings-only view
assertionMap.assertions: Actual hub My classes action navigates to member/classes section bookings; route mounts ClassesPane bookingsOnly=true and excludes Training.

limits: These are host-rendered/unit fixtures, not fresh device pixels or five end-to-end Cloud save journeys.
The native five-type matrix starts from mocked saved-type context; the separate provider assertions verify fetched organization/cache behavior for dance,yoga,martial_arts.
Chronological fixture evidence is two same-zone distinct starts; equal-start stable tie ordering and arbitrary cross-zone chronological permutations are not separately certified here.
Removed selection assertion establishes recovery to valid visible rows; no claim about an active All chip visual marker.

No claim that these suites alone prove live SQL eligibility, frozen-membership refusal, serialization, attendance, or tenant safety. Required existing full DB/seed gates remain independent and pending.
